qualification_observations: Clean v9 qualification includes installed Table/List/KeyValue kernel selection, menus and separate-client clipboard, editor and VTE clipboard/menu/IME, native GTK idle/two-broker-CPU-job presentation, and synthetic Wayland presentation. The exact immutable runtime passed all 60 development reproduction checks.
The prior v6, v7 and v8 distributions remain untouched. Only the redundant guest v8 builder output was removed after fresh SHA-256 equality with the retained host distribution.

An initial qualification-script attempt used the prior runtime ID after successful rollback and stopped before input tests. Development disks/configuration were restored and UTM closed. The helper now derives identity from candidate metadata; the complete fresh-copy run is recorded here.

A second fixture attempt refused a retained temporary password before account creation; the disposable guest was powered off after orderly shutdown timed out, original disks/configuration restored and UTM closed. A third attempt reached editor/primary transfer but failed to focus its destination. An instrumented repeat on that booted copy passed without a runtime change; that intermittent input observation remains open.
The new image uses supported zlib-compressed QCOW2 export. Its unbooted signed artifact remains separate from the verification copy.
